name: Gypsies
overview: Scripture calls believers to courage and trust in God's presence wherever they go, reminding us that with God nothing is impossible and that salvation comes only through Jesus Christ, who is the way, the truth, and the life. God's love is extended to all people, promising eternal life to those who believe in Him. At the same time, the Bible commands believers to love one another as Christ has loved us, while upholding God's standards of holiness and righteousness.
